x: The start, as was only to be expected, was very fast, but Harry Churcher, an individual entrant from our Club, was soon in the lead. At six miles, when still leading, he suffered disqualification, leaving the eventual winner, F.
Actually, he finished sixth, and covered 20 miles 1122 yards—highly creditable. Congratulations to F.
Next came the three miles, and in this we had an excellent race between F.

Their win was an impressive one, and their scoring three—Harold Whitlock (1), Rex Whitlock (3) and Fred Redman (11)—well deserved their gold Championship medals, and the honour of winning the first Senior Championship for their club.
All started, and claret and gold vests were soon prominent at the head of the field. Harry Churcher eventually had an easy win from F.
